## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit carries a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s` → `Signed-off-by: Name <email>`; see CONTRIBUTING.md). No CLA is required.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass locally; `CLI_PACK_SMOKE=1 pnpm test` too if packaging, `scripts/` or `plugins/` changed.
- [ ] Tests cover the change where it is testable; goldens were regenerated by the script that owns them, never edited by hand.
- [ ] The doc that owns the behaviour is updated in this pull request.
- [ ] No credential, transcript, real account or real path in any fixture; no secret in a hook argument.
- [ ] No reserved identity is introduced or reused (`@jentrix/*`, marketplace/plugin name `jentrix`; TRADEMARKS.md).
